# 2026 Merrimack Warriors football team

}}
The 2026 Merrimack Warriors football team represented Merrimack College as an independent during the 2026 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Warriors were led by third-year head coach Mike Gennetti and played home games at Duane Stadium in North Andover, Massachusetts.
